summary: Fortis Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing an underwriting agreement and pricing term sheet for a US$1.0 billion debt offering: US$500 million of 6.625% fixed-to-fixed rate junior subordinated notes due 2057 (NC5) and US$500 million of 6.875% fixed-to-fixed rate junior subordinated notes due 2057 (NC10), priced September 9, 2026 under a December 2024 Canadian shelf prospectus, via Morgan Stanley, MUFG, Wells Fargo and BofA as representatives. This is a routine debt capital markets issuance incorporated by reference into the F-10, not a special situation.
